name: Scenario 1: Deployment Failure
description: Simulates a release regression in production-api:v42 introducing a memory leak that causes OutOfMemory errors and HTTP 5xx spikes.

name: Scenario 2: Database Performance Degradation
description: Simulates database connection pool exhaustion caused by hanging unindexed queries.

name: Scenario 3: Traffic Spike Capacity Saturation
description: Simulates a 300% request volume surge exceeding Auto-Scaling Group capacity quotas.
